return-response.set-body: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("error", "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE"), new JProperty("message", "The request body exceeds the maximum allowed size."), new JProperty("correlationId", (string)context.Variables["correlationId"])).ToString(); }

set-variable.name: validationError

return-response.set-body: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("error", "REQUEST_VALIDATION_FAILED"), new JProperty("message", (string)context.Variables["validationError"]), new JProperty("correlationId", (string)context.Variables["correlationId"])).ToString(); }
